title: Linking Words Loom
intro: However, although, despite, in spite of — weave the right connector into the sentence without breaking the logic or the grammar.

It was cold, but I wore a coat.
It was cold, so, I wore a coat.
I like tea, but I prefer coffee.
I like tea, so I prefer coffee.
I like tea but, I prefer coffee.
